item.title: NJ Pilot, Co-Pilot Held Nearly Six Weeks in West Africa
item.description: NJ pilot and co-pilot held for nearly six weeks in West African country.

item.title: Iran Fortifies Isfahan Nuclear Site Amid Fears of Possible Strike
item.description: Iran fortifies Isfahan nuclear site amid attack concerns •⁠ ⁠Satellite images show Iran sealing tunnels at the Isfahan nuclear facility, apparently to protect the site from a possible attack. •⁠ ⁠The images indicate soil and earth were placed over tunnel entrances, making underground access more difficult and concealing key areas. •⁠ ⁠Analysts say the measures […]

item.description: First foreign force prepares to deploy to Gaza •⁠ ⁠Preparations are underway to absorb thousands of Indonesian soldiers into Gaza as part of an international stabilization force. •⁠ ⁠The Indonesian contingent is expected to be integrated into an international stabilization framework operating in the Strip. •⁠ ⁠The designated deployment area for the troops, between Rafah […]

item.title: Two Injured After Small Plane Crashes Into Cars in Georgia
item.description: Two people were taken to the hospital with minor injuries after a small plane crashed into cars while making an emergency landing on a road in Gainesville, Georgia, earlier today.

item.title: Appeals Court Clears Path to End TPS for Nepal, Honduras, Nicaragua Immigrants
item.description: Appeals court allows move to end TPS protections •⁠ ⁠A federal appeals court in San Francisco granted a stay allowing the administration to move forward with ending Temporary Protected Status (TPS) for immigrants from Nepal, Honduras, and Nicaragua. •⁠ ⁠The Ninth Circuit paused a lower court ruling that had blocked the decision by Kristi Noem […]

item.title: Trump Expected to Visit Beijing in April for Summit With Xi
item.description: POLITICO reports that President Trump is expected to travel to Beijing during the first week of April for a long-anticipated summit with Chinese President Xi Jinping.

item.title: Trump Predicts Landslide Midterm Victory Amid Strong Economy
item.description: Trump on the midterm elections later this year: “Now we have the hottest country anywhere in the world… I guess I have to sell that because we should win in a landslide, and we’ll do everything we can to do it.”

item.title: Air Canada Suspends Cuba Flights Amid Jet Fuel Shortage
item.description: Air Canada announced it is suspending flights to Cuba after the island warned it is running low on jet fuel, as the United States tightens restrictions on oil shipments from Venezuela.

item.title: Flight Attendants Union Passes No-Confidence Vote in American Airlines CEO
item.description: The union that represents American Airlines flight attendants said Monday its board of directors unanimously passed a no-confidence vote in airline CEO Robert Isom, the first such vote against an American Airlines CEO in the union’s history.
